name: awgraph
description: A code knowledge graph for agents: symbols, call paths and dependencies, served as the few chunks a task needs instead of a grep dump.
notes: Metrics are retrieval measurements over 15 real commits with k=10, where the task is a commit message with answer filenames stripped and the truth is the files that commit modified.
grep scored HIGHER recall (0.933 vs 0.800). The claim here is cost, not superiority: 86% of grep's recall for 0.43% of its context.
Embedding coverage on that run was 33.3%, so the recall figure understates the semantic half.
A naive graph-then-grep fusion was measured at 0.933 recall / 352,872 tokens - more expensive than grep alone, because the fallback fires on nearly every task. Recorded because it did not work.
